els.description: Monument to the Union regiments who participated in "Upton's Charge" on May 10, 1864. 12 regiments under Col. Emory Upton attacked four Rebel brigades in their defenses. Both sides suffered some 1,000 casualties, the attack failing to secure the defenses.
els.name: Upton's Charge Monument

els.description: Placed by Col. Charles E. Phelps, commanding 7th Maryland Infantry, part of the "Maryland Brigade". On May 8, 1864 the brigade attacked the Confederate line on Laurel Hill and were repulsed after heavy fighting. Phelps would receive the Medal of Honor.
els.name: Maryland Brigade Monument
Fredericksburg and Spotsylvania National Military Park
els.wikipedia: en:Fredericksburg and Spotsylvania National Military Park

els.description: House built around 1800 owned by the McCoull family during the war. House survived the horrific fighting around the Mule Shoe, of which it was located in the center. Destroyed by fire in 1921. Cut stones marking the house's outline were placed in 2007.
els.name: McCoull House
